description: Full device/session state for what is playing right now — item, progress, plus shuffle/repeat mode, active device, and volume. For a lightweight item+progress poll use get_currently_playing instead.

additional_types.description: Item types to include in the response. Default: ['track', 'episode']

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code — localises item names; lowercase input is uppercased; defaults to SPOTIFY_MCP_MARKET

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: get_now_playing
